blocks.raw: # Enrolling and Issuing Badges from Campaigns
blocks.text: Enrolling and Issuing Badges from Campaigns

blocks.raw: # Enrolling customers in a Badge through Campaign
blocks.text: Enrolling customers in a Badge through Campaign

blocks.raw: To enrol your customers in a Badge through a Campaign, follow the below steps:
blocks.text: To enrol your customers in a Badge through a Campaign, follow the below steps:

blocks.raw: 1. Go to **Campaigns > New Campaign> Create a message**.
blocks.text: Go to Campaigns > New Campaign> Create a message.

blocks.raw: <Image align="center" className="border" border={true} src="https://files.readme.io/0cc73a5-Screenshot_2024-04-22_at_5.22.03_PM.png" />

target.note: keep src/alt (+ width/height when real); drop align, border, className, and width="smart"

blocks.raw: 2. Navigate to the **Creatives+Incentives** section and click on **Add Incentives > Enrol Badge**.
blocks.text: Navigate to the Creatives+Incentives section and click on Add Incentives > Enrol Badge.

blocks.raw: <Image align="center" className="border" border={true} src="https://files.readme.io/8f5ef76-Screenshot_2024-04-22_at_5.22.56_PM.png" />

target.note: keep src/alt (+ width/height when real); drop align, border, className, and width="smart"

blocks.raw:
3. From the **LIVE and UPCOMING** badges list, select the Badge in which you want to enrol the audience. Make sure you are selecting only **ACTIVE** badges and the badge end date doesn't end before the campaign duration.\
   **Note**: All the badges, regardless of ownership, are displayed. The ownership of badges indicates the module where the badge will be used. For example, Loyalty, Loyalty Promotion, Journeys, etc. This is defined during the creation of a badge.\
   You can also select **New badge** and create a new badge if required. Only Enrol & Issue badges can be created and owner type can be any.

blocks.raw: # Issue badges to customers through Campaign
blocks.text: Issue badges to customers through Campaign

blocks.raw: ## How to issue badge to customers?
blocks.text: How to issue badge to customers?

blocks.raw: To issue badges to your customers through a Campaign, follow the below steps:
blocks.text: To issue badges to your customers through a Campaign, follow the below steps:

blocks.raw: 1. Go to **Campaigns > New Campaign> Create a message**.
blocks.text: Go to Campaigns > New Campaign> Create a message.

blocks.raw: <Image align="center" className="border" border={true} src="https://files.readme.io/c236fb1-Screenshot_2024-04-23_at_2.17.29_PM.png" />

target.note: keep src/alt (+ width/height when real); drop align, border, className, and width="smart"

blocks.raw: 2. Navigate to the **Creatives+Incentives** section and click on **Add Incentives > Issue Badge**.
blocks.text: Navigate to the Creatives+Incentives section and click on Add Incentives > Issue Badge.

blocks.raw: <Image align="center" className="border" border={true} src="https://files.readme.io/526866b-Screenshot_2024-04-23_at_2.17.43_PM.png" />

blocks.raw:
3. From the **LIVE and UPCOMING** badges list, select the Badge that you want to issue to the audience. Make sure you are selecting only **ACTIVE** badges and the badge end date doesn't end before the campaign duration.\
   **Note:** Only "Direct Issue" type badges and badges owned by `audience campaigns` are displayed.\
   You can also select **New badge** and create a new badge if required. Only Direct Issue badges can be created and owner type can be only Audience Campaigns.
